title: Lemon Butter Parmesan Asparagus
description: Oven-roasted asparagus finished under the broiler with lemon, butter, and parmesan.

ingredients.item: lemon, half juiced and half sliced into rings
black pepper, freshly ground, or to taste
shredded parmesan cheese, or to taste

steps.do: Arrange the trimmed asparagus in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet. Drizzle with the olive oil, season with the salt and pepper, and roll to coat evenly.
uses: black pepper, freshly ground, or to taste

steps.do: Squeeze the juice of half the lemon over the asparagus. Lay the lemon rings across the top third of the spears, then scatter the butter pats over the center.
uses: lemon, half juiced and half sliced into rings

steps.do: Roast at 400F (200C) for 8 to 10 minutes, until just fork-tender — thin spears finish nearer 8 minutes, thick spears nearer 12 minutes. Pull the pan and switch the oven to broil.
Scatter the parmesan over the center of the asparagus and broil 2 to 3 minutes, until melted and golden.
uses: shredded parmesan cheese, or to taste

notes: To trim: hold each spear at the base, bend until it snaps naturally (usually 1 to 2 inches from the base); for thick stalks, peel the fibrous skin off the bottom half instead.
Bake time scales with thickness: thin spears about 8 minutes, medium about 10 minutes, thick about 12 minutes, all followed by the same broil.
Make-ahead: bake fully, cover, and refrigerate; reheat gently in the oven before serving (per the author, replying to readers).
Several readers report good results in an air fryer, though this isn't a technique the author has tested herself — start checking a few minutes early.
Good without the parmesan if you want it dairy-light; a scatter of lemon zest in its place is a reader favorite.
nutrition: Per serving: 109 cal · 6 g carbs · 4 g protein · 9 g fat
